name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 16 – Am 16
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 16b. Stresses that the number of Ukrainians identified as victims of human trafficking in the European Union is alarmingly high, and has increased since Russia’s full-scale invasion; calls on the Member States to increase their support, including through economic means, for the victims and for preventative measures;
